decision: Preserve original sealed design; do not implement this structurally homogeneous cohort. New accepted design-v2 cohort retains T1 and independently replaces T2/T3 with materially different UI compositions.
reason: All three original layouts share two equal-width choices, optional control, disclosure, confirmation and long notes. Domain-rule transfer alone does not satisfy the requested breadth of complex UI style tasks.
selectionBasis: Public design completeness only, before implementation or any arm outcome. No tool, original approval, expectation, result or sealed artifact is rewritten. Fixed six memberships/phase budgets and all prospective cohort barriers remain unchanged.
